method: Original Playwright whole-UI silent recording; MP4 conversion preserves decoded frame count and time, without changing frame rate or speed. Mobile is the final65s of the same recording, no synthetic/gameplay substitute. Both streams fully decoded by the bundled FFmpeg7.1.
actual_renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (0x00002216) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

source.stream: vp8, yuv420p(progressive), 1280x800, SAR 1:1 DAR 8:5, 25 fps, 25 tbr, 1k tbn

full.stream: h264 (High) (avc1 / 0x31637661), yuv420p(tv, bt470bg/unknown/unknown, progressive), 1280x800 [SAR 1:1 DAR 8:5], 1332 kb/s, 25 fps, 25 tbr, 12800 tbn (default)

mobile.stream: h264 (High) (avc1 / 0x31637661), yuv420p(tv, bt470bg/unknown/unknown, progressive), 1280x800 [SAR 1:1 DAR 8:5], 1054 kb/s, 25 fps, 25 tbr, 12800 tbn (default)

gpu_measurement_scope: Two600-interval Cosmos samples while video capture is enabled; headless desktop workload, not isolated GPU or whole-world qualification.
